roadmap.title: Story and key scans
roadmap.description: Play the main story to the end and Focus scan Specter and Specter Prime in the final quest.

roadmap.title: Skills and early levels
roadmap.description: Spend early skill points on the Warrior tree for melee combos, then Valor Surge, weapon techniques and one full tree.

roadmap.title: Open-world activities
roadmap.description: Use the flying mount to clear Tallnecks, Cauldrons, Rebel Camps, Hunting Grounds, Gauntlet Runs and collectibles.

roadmap.title: Side quests
roadmap.description: Finish the specific side quests, flying-mount quests, Salvage Contracts and the Melee Pits for the Enduring.

roadmap.title: Machines, gear and cleanup
roadmap.description: Kill machine types, ride mounts, upgrade gear and fill the remaining small achievements.

roadmap.title: Burning Shores
roadmap.description: Finish the expansion story, side quests, Cauldron THETA, collectibles and new skills.

roadmap.title: New Game+ and Ultra Hard
roadmap.description: Replay for New Game+ and Ultra Hard, and earn 125 Champion's Tokens for the rewards.

achievements.description: Obtained all Horizon Forbidden West Achievements.
achievements.summary: Obtain every base-game achievement.

steps.text: Earn every achievement from Reached Level 20 through Used Dye Flowers; the New Game+ and Burning Shores ones are not required.

achievements.description: Reached player level 20.
achievements.summary: Reach player level 20.

steps.text: Keep playing the story and doing quests, hunts and activities until you reach level 20.

achievements.description: Reached player level 30.
achievements.summary: Reach player level 30.

steps.text: Keep playing the story and doing quests, hunts and activities until you reach level 30.

achievements.description: Reached player level 50.
achievements.summary: Reach player level 50.

guide.context: Apex machines show up more often at night and are worth extra XP. A Shelter lets you skip ahead to night.

steps.text: Keep clearing trophy activities and side quests until you reach level 50.
If you are short, kill a large combat machine such as @enemy{Tremortusk} on Story difficulty, fast travel to another machine site and repeat.

achievements.description: Finish the mission The Point of the Lance (the second story mission) to arrive at the Daunt.
achievements.summary: Finish the mission The Point of the Lance (the second story mission) to arrive at the Daunt.

steps.text: Play through the story mission @item{The Point of the Lance} to its end.

achievements.description: Finish the story mission To the Brink (the third) to reopen the Daunt.
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission To the Brink (the third) to reopen the Daunt.

steps.text: Play through the story mission @item{To the Brink} to its end.

achievements.description: Finish the story mission The Embassy (the fourth).
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission The Embassy (the fourth).

steps.text: Play through the story mission @item{The Embassy} to its end.

achievements.description: Set up the Base and reboot GAIA in the story mission The Eye of the Earth (the seventh).
achievements.summary: Set up the Base and reboot GAIA in the story mission The Eye of the Earth (the seventh).

steps.text: In @item{The Eye of the Earth}, talk to GAIA until the game tells you to leave through the west door.

achievements.description: Recover AETHER by finishing the story mission The Kulrut.
achievements.summary: Recover AETHER by finishing the story mission The Kulrut.

guide.context: You can do the AETHER, POSEIDON and DEMETER quests in any order.

steps.text: Finish the story mission @item{The Kulrut}.

achievements.description: Recover POSEIDON by finishing the story mission The Sea of Sands.
achievements.summary: Recover POSEIDON by finishing the story mission The Sea of Sands.

steps.text: Finish the story mission @item{The Sea of Sands}.

achievements.description: Recover DEMETER by finishing the story mission Seeds of the Past.
achievements.summary: Recover DEMETER by finishing the story mission Seeds of the Past.

steps.text: Finish the story mission @item{Seeds of the Past}.

achievements.description: Bring Beta back to the base by finishing the story mission Cradle of Echoes.
achievements.summary: Bring Beta back to the base by finishing the story mission Cradle of Echoes.

steps.text: Finish the story mission @item{Cradle of Echoes}.

achievements.description: Finish the story mission Faro's Tomb.
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission Faro's Tomb.

steps.text: Finish the story mission @item{Faro's Tomb}.

achievements.displayName: Flew on the Wings of the Ten
achievements.description: Finish the story mission The Wings of the Ten.
achievements.summary: Finish the story mission The Wings of the Ten.

steps.text: Finish the story mission @item{The Wings of the Ten}.

achievements.description: Finish the final main quest, Singularity.
achievements.summary: Finish the final main quest, Singularity.

steps.text: Play @item{Singularity}, the final main quest, and Focus scan Specter and Specter Prime when they appear.
Finish the quest. Dialogue choices do not matter.

achievements.description: Finish the three Arrowhand quests that decide the Desert Commander.
achievements.summary: Finish the three Arrowhand quests that decide the Desert Commander.

steps.text: Start @item{Thirst for the Hunt} in @loc{Arrowhand}, a small settlement south-west of your base.
Finish @item{The Wound in the Sand}.
Finish @item{The Gate of the Vanquished}.

achievements.description: Finish the four Daunt side quests: The Bristlebacks, The Twilight Path, Shadow from the Past and Shadow in the West.
achievements.summary: Finish the four Daunt side quests: The Bristlebacks, The Twilight Path, Shadow from the Past and Shadow in the West.

steps.text: Finish @item{The Bristlebacks}; it is accepted automatically early in the story.
Talk to Petra in @loc{Chainscrape} to start @item{The Twilight Path}, then finish it.
Talk to the prisoner in @loc{Barren Light} to start @item{Shadow from the Past}, then finish it.
Finish the follow-up quest @item{Shadow in the West}, which starts automatically.

achievements.description: Finish the side quest What Was Lost.
achievements.summary: Finish the side quest What Was Lost.

steps.text: Accept @item{What Was Lost} from Kotallo in your base during the story, or next to Hekkaro's Throne in @loc{the Memorial Grove} after the final mission.
Finish the quest.

achievements.description: Finish the side quest The Second Verse.
achievements.summary: Finish the side quest The Second Verse.

steps.text: Accept @item{The Second Verse} from Zo in your base during the story, or on the upper floor of @loc{Plainsong} after the final mission.
Finish the quest.

achievements.description: Finish the side quest Forbidden Legacy.
achievements.summary: Finish the side quest Forbidden Legacy.

steps.text: Accept @item{Forbidden Legacy} from Alva in your base during the story, or at @loc{Legacy's Landfall}, the Quen base far to the west, after the final mission.
Finish the quest.

achievements.description: Reach the top of any Tallneck and access its data.
achievements.summary: Reach the top of any Tallneck and access its data.

steps.text: Climb a Tallneck and interact at its top to override it.

achievements.description: Override all 6 Tallnecks.
achievements.summary: Override all 6 Tallnecks.

steps.text: Climb and override every Tallneck on the map.
The Tallneck in the middle of the map becomes available only during a late main quest.
Another Tallneck is hidden inside the northernmost Cauldron.

achievements.description: Complete key objectives in one Rebel Camp.
achievements.summary: Complete key objectives in one Rebel Camp.

steps.text: Go to a Rebel Camp on the map and complete its key objectives.

achievements.description: Clear all six Rebel Camps and help Erend defeat Asera.
achievements.summary: Clear all six Rebel Camps and help Erend defeat Asera.

steps.text: Clear every Rebel Camp except the north-western one.
Go to the north-western camp, which unlocks only after the other five, and help Erend defeat Asera.

achievements.description: Reach the Core of an open-world Cauldron and access its data.
achievements.summary: Reach the Core of an open-world Cauldron and access its data.

guide.context: The Cauldron that the story forces on you in The Dying Lands does not count here.

steps.text: Complete a Cauldron that is not part of the main story and interact with its Core.

achievements.description: Reach the Core of every Cauldron and access its data.
achievements.summary: Reach the Core of every Cauldron and access its data.

steps.text: Complete all 6 Cauldrons, including the two that are part of the main story.

achievements.displayName: Obtained 3 Stripes at a Hunting Ground
achievements.description: Score a Quarter Stripe or better on each of the three trials of a single Hunting Ground.
achievements.summary: Score a Quarter Stripe or better on each of the three trials of a single Hunting Ground.

steps.text: Visit a Hunting Ground and play its three trials, getting at least a Quarter Stripe on each.

achievements.displayName: Obtained 3 Stripes at All Hunting Grounds
achievements.description: Earn at least a Quarter Stripe in all 12 trials across the four Hunting Grounds.
achievements.summary: Earn at least a Quarter Stripe in all 12 trials across the four Hunting Grounds.

guide.context: You do not need a full-stripe score; the lowest mark is enough.

steps.text: Do the three trials at each of the 4 Hunting Grounds, scoring at least a Quarter Stripe on every one.

achievements.description: Killed at least one of every type of Acquisition machine.
achievements.summary: Kill at least one of every Acquisition machine type.

guide.context: Any one variant of each type counts. Check Notebook > Statistics > Machines Killed for gaps.

steps.text: Kill at least one machine of each type: Bristleback, Charger, Clamberjaw, Fanghorn, Fireclaw, Frostclaw, Glinthawk, Grazer, Lancehorn, Plowhorn, Rockbreaker, Scrapper, Scrounger, Snapmaw, Spikesnout, Sunwing, Tideripper, Widemaw.

achievements.description: Killed at least one of every type of Reconnaissance machine.
achievements.summary: Kill at least one of every Recon machine type.

guide.context: Tallnecks cannot be killed and are not needed.

steps.text: Kill at least one machine of each type: Burrower, Skydrifter, Longleg, Redeye Watcher.

achievements.description: Killed at least one of every type of Combat machine.
achievements.summary: Kill at least one of every Combat machine type.

guide.context: A kill counts only if you land the final blow. Check Notebook > Statistics > Machines Killed.

steps.text: Kill at least one machine of each type: Clawstrider, Corruptor, Dreadwing, Grimhorn, Ravager, Scorcher, Shellsnapper, Slaughterspine, Slitherfang, Specter, Specter Prime, Stalker, Stormbird, Thunderjaw, Tremortusk.

achievements.description: Killed at least one of every type of Transport machine.
achievements.summary: Kill at least one of every Transport machine type.

steps.text: Kill at least one machine of each type: Leaplasher, Bellowback, Shell-Walker, Rollerback, Behemoth.

achievements.description: Ride a Charger, a Bristleback and a Clawstrider.
achievements.summary: Ride a Charger, a Bristleback and a Clawstrider.

steps.text: Override and mount a @enemy{Charger}; its override is available from the start.
Finish the TAU Cauldron (part of The Dying Lands) to unlock the Bristleback override, then override and mount a @enemy{Bristleback}.
Finish the IOTA Cauldron to unlock the Clawstrider override, then override and mount a @enemy{Clawstrider}.

achievements.description: Encountered and Focus scanned every type of machine.
achievements.summary: Focus scan every one of the 43 machine types.

guide.context: The final story mission cannot be replayed. If Specter is missed, New Game+ or the Burning Shores main quests give another chance.

steps.text: Focus scan one machine of each type; any variant counts. Check Notebook > Machine Catalogue for gaps.
Scan Specter and Specter Prime during the final quest Singularity.

achievements.description: Glide for 60 seconds without touching the ground.
achievements.summary: Glide for 60 seconds without touching the ground.

steps.text: Once you have the flying mount, fly as high as possible, dismount and open the glider immediately.
Glide down toward the ground. From that height the glide should last over a minute.

achievements.description: Finish two quests that require the flying mount.
achievements.summary: Finish two quests that require the flying mount.

steps.text: Pick any two of these quests and finish them: @item{Tides of Justice}, @item{The Way Home}, @item{First to Fly}, @item{Shining Example}.

achievements.description: Place first in two separate Gauntlet Run races.
achievements.summary: Place first in two separate Gauntlet Run races.

steps.text: Go to the first Gauntlet Run in the valley south-west of your base and win the race.
Do the next Gauntlet Run that this adds to your quest log and win it too.

achievements.displayName: Completed a Set of Salvage Contracts
achievements.description: Finish all four contracts of one Salvage Contractor.
achievements.summary: Finish all four contracts of one Salvage Contractor.

steps.text: Go to the Salvage Contractor about 300 metres south-west of @loc{Barren Light}.
Complete his four contracts: Convoy Ambush, Scavengers, Alarm Antennas and Elusive Fanghorn.

achievements.description: Defeat the leader and recover the tag at four Rebel Outposts.
achievements.summary: Defeat the leader and recover the tag at four Rebel Outposts.

guide.context: Some leaders carry a key to a chest that holds the tag instead of the tag itself.

steps.text: At an outpost, kill the leader and loot the Soldier Tag, then leave the area. Repeat at 3 more outposts.

achievements.description: Complete three Relic Ruins.
achievements.summary: Complete three Relic Ruins.

steps.text: Find and solve any 3 Relic Ruins.

achievements.description: Complete one Arena challenge set.
achievements.summary: Complete one Arena challenge set.

steps.text: Finish the main quest @item{The Kulrut} to unlock the Arena near the middle of the map.
Complete the side quest @item{Opening the Arena}, then speak with the Arena Master a second time.
Finish the four fights of the Easy playlist.

achievements.description: Win a Machine Strike match against two different challengers.
achievements.summary: Win a Machine Strike match against two different challengers.

guide.context: The Chainscrape tutorial matches are not counted, but Beginner's Practice: Easy is.

steps.text: Play the Machine Strike opponent in the @loc{Chainscrape} tavern and win the first match, Beginner's Practice: Easy.
Beat the first board of the opponent in @loc{Barren Light}.

achievements.description: Obtained 1 weapon from every weapon class.
achievements.summary: Obtain one weapon from each weapon class.

steps.text: Buy one weapon of each class from Hunter merchants in settlements: Blastsling, Boltblaster, Hunter Bow, Ropecaster, Sharpshot Bow, Shredder Gauntlet, Spike Thrower, Tripcaster, Warrior Bow.

achievements.description: Inflicted every elemental state on an enemy at least once.
achievements.summary: Inflict all six elemental states on an enemy.

steps.text: Apply Fire, Frost, Shock, Acid, Purgewater and Plasma to enemies, using elemental weapons or by shooting machine canisters.

achievements.description: Successfully performed 3 different unlockable melee combos.
achievements.summary: Perform three different unlockable melee combos on enemies.

guide.context: A combo has to hit an enemy to count.

steps.text: Buy 3 melee combos in the Warrior skill tree.
Hit enemies with each of the 3 combos.

achievements.description: Performed a stealth kill on 10 machines.
achievements.summary: Stealth kill 10 machines.

guide.context: Silent strikes on machines that have noticed you do not count. Small machines such as Chargers work well.

steps.text: Sneak up on unaware machines while crouched and use the silent strike. Repeat until 10 are done.

achievements.description: Detached 100 components from machines.
achievements.summary: Detach 100 components from machines.

steps.text: Shoot weak points and components off machines while fighting.

achievements.description: Picked up 5 different heavy weapons.
achievements.summary: Pick up five different heavy weapons dropped by machines.

guide.context: Heavy weapons come from Stalkers, Grimhorns, Ravagers, Dreadwings, Shellsnappers, Thunderjaws, Scorchers, Slitherfangs, Tremortusks, Slaughterspines and Specters.

steps.text: Shoot the heavy weapon off a large machine, then pick it up. Do this with 5 different machine types.

achievements.description: Unlocked and used the overrides for 10 different types of machine.
achievements.summary: Use the overrides of 10 different machine types.

guide.context: Apex variants cannot be overridden. If a machine turns hostile, leave the area and come back.

steps.text: Finish the Cauldrons to unlock overrides.
Approach machines stealthily and hold the override button on 10 different types.

achievements.description: Defeat the Enduring, the Tenakth melee master.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Enduring, the Tenakth melee master.

steps.text: Learn every melee combo in the Warrior skill tree.
Complete all 4 Melee Pits, then track and do the quest @item{The Enduring}.

achievements.description: Raise one Valor Surge to its maximum level (level 3).
achievements.summary: Raise one Valor Surge to its maximum level (level 3).

steps.text: Buy the skills connected to a Valor Surge, then equip it and hold the upgrade button until it reaches level 3.

achievements.description: Fully upgraded 3 weapons.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade three weapons.

steps.text: Upgrade 3 uncommon (green) weapons to their maximum at a workbench.
Use Create Job in the upgrade menu if you lack the materials.

achievements.description: Fully upgraded 3 different outfits.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade three outfits.

steps.text: Upgrade 3 uncommon (green) outfits to their maximum at a workbench.

achievements.description: Upgraded the Food Pouch, Potion Pouch, Resource Pouch, Trap Pouch, and any ammo pouch at least once.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the Food, Potion, Resource and Trap pouches and one ammo pouch.

steps.text: Buy food from a Cook and a potion from a Herbalist so those pouches appear.
At a workbench, upgrade the Food, Potion, Resource and Trap pouches and any one ammo pouch.

achievements.description: Equipped a weapon of any tier with 2 coils.
achievements.summary: Equip a weapon with two coils at once.

guide.context: Uncommon (green) weapons only have one coil slot.

steps.text: Use a rare (blue) or better weapon, upgraded to 2 coil slots if needed.
Slot any two coils into it.

achievements.description: Unlock a weapon technique for three different weapon classes.
achievements.summary: Unlock a weapon technique for three different weapon classes.

guide.context: Three techniques for the same weapon do not count.

steps.text: Buy one Weapon Technique each for 3 different weapons, for example Ropecaster, Hunter Bow and Boltblaster.

achievements.description: Learned all available skills on one tree.
achievements.summary: Learn every skill on one skill tree.

guide.context: Trapper has the fewest skills, about 40 skill points in total.

steps.text: Pick one tree and buy all of its skills, including raising its Valor Surge to level 3. The Trapper tree is the cheapest.

achievements.description: Complete one of each collectible: Survey Drone, Black Box, Relic Ruin, Vista Point and Signal Tower.
achievements.summary: Complete one of each collectible: Survey Drone, Black Box, Relic Ruin, Vista Point and Signal Tower.

steps.text: Complete one Survey Drone, one Black Box, one Relic Ruin, one Vista Point and one Signal Tower.

achievements.description: Use blooms at a dyer to get a new dye and put it on your outfit.
achievements.summary: Use blooms at a dyer to get a new dye and put it on your outfit.

guide.context: Pick a dye that costs blooms; dyes that only cost shards do not count.

steps.text: Climb mountainsides to pick blooms.
Go to a Dyer, for example in @loc{Plainsong}, choose a dye that uses blooms and apply it.

achievements.description: Completed a New Game+ playthrough on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the story of a New Game+ run, whatever the difficulty.

guide.context: Do the first New Game+ on an easier difficulty so you can still change it. Starting on Ultra Hard locks you into it.

steps.text: Start a New Game+ and finish its story, preferably on Story difficulty.

achievements.description: Completed a new or New Game+ playthrough on Ultra Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Ultra Hard.

guide.context: Ultra Hard unlocks after you finish the main story. The Burning Shores story is not required.

steps.text: Pick Ultra Hard for a fresh game or a New Game+ run and see its story through.

achievements.description: Obtained all New Game+ weapons, dyes, and face paints.
achievements.summary: Purchase every New Game+ reward with Champion's Tokens: eight weapons, four dyes and five face paints.

guide.context: You need 125 Champion's Tokens, earned only in New Game+. Main quests give 2 each; Rebel Camps, Cauldrons and supporting-character side quests give 3; most other quests give 2. Tokens carry over between New Game+ saves.

collectibles.name: Tears of the Land-God
collectibles.method: Buy this Hunter Bow from any Hunter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Brawlbreaker
collectibles.method: Buy this Boltblaster from any Hunter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: The Final Chapter
collectibles.method: Buy this Shredder Gauntlet from any Hunter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: All-Mother's Blessing
collectibles.method: Buy this Tripcaster from any Hunter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Defiance
collectibles.method: Buy this Spike Thrower from any Hunter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Legacy's Reach
collectibles.method: Buy this Blastsling from any Hunter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Iriv's Downfall
collectibles.method: Buy this Sharpshot Bow from any Hunter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Rain of Sparks
collectibles.method: Buy this Warrior Bow from any Hunter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Burnished Sun
collectibles.method: Buy this Carja dye from any Dyer once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Hunter's Dusk
collectibles.method: Buy this Nora dye from any Dyer once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Scorched Ochre
collectibles.method: Buy this Tenakth dye from any Dyer once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Harvest Haze
collectibles.method: Buy this Utaru dye from any Dyer once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Quen Officer
collectibles.method: Buy this face paint from any Painter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Quen Imperial
collectibles.method: Buy this face paint from any Painter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Quen Relic Hunter
collectibles.method: Buy this face paint from any Painter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Quen Navigator
collectibles.method: Buy this face paint from any Painter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

collectibles.name: Quen Light-Weaver
collectibles.method: Buy this face paint from any Painter once you have enough Champion's Tokens.

achievements.description: Finish all Burning Shores main quests and side quests, including the epilogue.
achievements.summary: Finish all Burning Shores main quests and side quests, including the epilogue.

guide.context: Door codes: Murmuring Hollow ruins 1315; A Friend in the Dark 117 and 1247. The epilogue starts at your base after His Final Act.

steps.text: Finish the 5 main quests.
Finish the side quests @item{In His Wake}, @item{The Splinter Within} and @item{A Friend in the Dark} (it starts after you solve the Murmuring Hollow relic ruins).
Finish the epilogue by returning to your base and talking to Sylens.

achievements.description: Finish the main quest The Stars in Their Eyes.
achievements.summary: Finish the main quest The Stars in Their Eyes.

guide.context: The Burning Shores needs the base-game story finished first. Heaven and Earth door code: 3285.

steps.text: Start the Burning Shores with the main quest @item{To the Burning Shores}.
Finish @item{Heaven and Earth}, then @item{The Stars in Their Eyes}.

achievements.description: Finish the main quest For His Amusement.
achievements.summary: Finish the main quest For His Amusement.

steps.text: Finish @item{For His Amusement}.

achievements.description: Complete both Fleet's End side quests, In His Wake and The Splinter Within.
achievements.summary: Complete both Fleet's End side quests, In His Wake and The Splinter Within.

steps.text: Accept @item{In His Wake} and @item{The Splinter Within} at @loc{Fleet's End}.
Complete each of them.

achievements.description: Finish the final Burning Shores main quest, His Final Act.
achievements.summary: Finish the final Burning Shores main quest, His Final Act.

steps.text: Finish @item{His Final Act}. Scan the Horus during the fight.

achievements.description: Learn all 18 new Burning Shores skills (72 skill points).
achievements.summary: Learn all 18 new Burning Shores skills (72 skill points).

guide.context: If short on points, make a manual save, reset the trees, buy the new skills, then reload the save. This respec trick may fail on PC.

steps.text: Buy the bottom skills of every skill tree, raising each Valor Surge to level 3.

achievements.description: Reached player level 60.
achievements.summary: Reach player level 60.

steps.text: Keep completing Burning Shores quests until you reach level 60.

achievements.description: Used Brimshine to purchase 1 outfit and 1 weapon.
achievements.summary: Spend Brimshine on one outfit and one weapon.

steps.text: Collect 16 Brimshine (8 per item).
Buy a Brimshine weapon from the Hunter and a Brimshine outfit from the Stitcher at @loc{Fleet's End}.

achievements.displayName: Equipped an Elite Coil or Weave
achievements.description: Equipped an elite coil on a weapon or an elite weave on an outfit.
achievements.summary: Equip one elite-tier coil on a weapon, or one elite-tier weave on an outfit.

steps.text: Buy or find an elite (orange) coil or weave, then equip it.

achievements.description: Install the Specter Gauntlet's single upgrade.
achievements.summary: Install the Specter Gauntlet's single upgrade.

steps.text: Finish @item{In His Wake}, started by talking to Otosu at @loc{Fleet's End}.
Kill the railgun enemy on the ledge and loot the upgrade.
Return to Fleet's End and slot the upgrade at the workbench.

achievements.description: Reach the core of Cauldron THETA and access its data.
achievements.summary: Reach the core of Cauldron THETA and access its data.

steps.text: Go to Cauldron THETA on the east side of the Burning Shores map.
Shoot the chillwater canisters that drones carry so they fall into lava and form geysers your Shieldwing can ride.
Defeat the Apex Bilegut at the end and access the core.

achievements.description: Encountered and Focus scanned every new machine in the Burning Shores.
achievements.summary: Focus scan all four Burning Shores machines: Bilegut, Stingspawn, Waterwing and Horus.

guide.context: Horus only appears in His Final Act and cannot be met in the open world afterwards. New Game+ gives another chance.

steps.text: Scan Bilegut and Stingspawn during @item{To the Burning Shores}.
Scan Waterwing during @item{For His Amusement}.
Scan Horus during @item{His Final Act}.

achievements.description: Find all 5 Pangea Figurines and solve the Dino Digits Quiz.
achievements.summary: Find all 5 Pangea Figurines and solve the Dino Digits Quiz.

guide.context: Each figurine needs a short puzzle. The park is reached in For His Amusement. Dimorphodon door code: 111464.

steps.text: Find the five figurines: Queen Rex, Dimorphodon, Green Raptor, Red Raptor and Reggie the Pterodactyl.
Go to the middle of Pangea Park, where there are 5 consoles.
Enter the codes from left to right: 6837, 4331, 378, 785, 1051.

achievements.description: Find all 7 Delver Trinkets and dig up their trove.
achievements.summary: Find all 7 Delver Trinkets and dig up their trove.

guide.context: Cherished Flask: from the campfire, drop into the water by the zip-line and use the crate as a platform. Lucky Porker: pull the rubble wall open and take the escalator down. Delver's Cap: use the yellow zip-line, then destroy the fire pot above. Hef the Hammer: climb the wooden platform into the cave.

steps.text: Find the 7 Delver Trinkets: Cherished Flask, Mighty Pint, Old Pot, Lucky Porker, Music Box, Delver's Cap and Hef the Hammer.
Dig up the final trove at the marked spot.

achievements.description: Discovered and completed all Aerial Captures.
achievements.summary: Discover and complete all 6 Aerial Captures.

guide.context: The north capture can bug if you do another capture first. Do it first and keep a manual save.

steps.text: At each black box, examine it, call your Waterwing and follow the Focus trail, then press the button at the eye symbol.
Do the north capture first, then northeast, east and northwest.
For the west capture, track and kill the Stormbird in the clouds first, then open the building door to find the black box.
The south capture appears on the map only after the first five.

achievements.description: Used Grapple Strike on 5 unique machines.
achievements.summary: Use Grapple Strike on 5 different machines.

steps.text: Learn Machine Grapple Strike in the Hunter tree.
Knock a machine down, jump at it and press the prompt to Grapple Strike. Do it on 5 different machines.

achievements.description: Killed 5 machines with the Specter Gauntlet while gliding.
achievements.summary: Take down 5 machines in mid-glide using the Specter Gauntlet.

guide.context: The progress counter can get stuck. Try to kill all 5 within a single glide.

steps.text: Learn Glide Targeting in the Hunter tree and equip the Specter Gauntlet.
Glide down from high up and shoot machines; Stingspawn work well.

achievements.description: Killed 5 Bileguts and 50 Stingspawn.
achievements.summary: Kill 5 Bileguts and 50 Stingspawn.

steps.text: Hunt at Bilegut sites, which also have Stingspawn eggs, or fight the Stingspawn inside Cauldron THETA.
Rest at a campfire to respawn the area if needed.
